_comment: Editable asset list. Change the PNG/TMX sources here, then run `make assets` to regenerate assets/generated/.
_comment_palette: Palette file and exported assembly label used by every image below.
_comment_images: Each image is cut into 8x8 Mode 0 tiles; tiles names become assembly labels in source order.

images._comment: Player ship and drone sprites from the sprites sheet.
Background tiles; symbol labels the start of the complete tileset.

_comment_tilemaps: Read the named TMX layer and export it as game_map; zx7b keeps the map compressed in the binary.
